text: The Mausoleum of Sparks is an ancient structure built by Tep himself somewhere in the deep layers of the Astral. The mighty sorcerer used it as a place for mysterious experiments on the Sparks of ordinary inhabitants of Sarnaut. Thanks to the life energy contained in the Sparks, which was extracted by enormous devices, Tep could work true miracles…

Islands from the mobile version of Allods.

The Allod of Copperlock

It is the home of the Kudiyar race. Once, in the ancient times of the Old Era, there lived a small tribe of Kudiyars. They led a secretive life and tried not to leave the forests, especially in daylight, for danger lurked all around. Their leader is Jeter, a young albino kudiyar, the successor to his father's rule.

The allod is divided into three parts:

The Centre is the most important structure in Copperlock. It houses various stations and workshops, the departure point of the cable car and all the government institutions. The only things the Centre lacks are dwellings and shops. All of those lie along the whole length of Copperlock's street.

The Working Allod

The neighbouring allods serve an economic purpose. Mining meteorite ore allowed the kudiyars to build airships capable of travelling from one allod to another. As already mentioned, two cable cars run downward from the Centre of Copperlock, each ending on a different outlying allod. One line runs through all the levels of the city and stops at every station. It leads to the Working Allod. On the Working Allod the kudiyars, naturally, work. There is a farm, sown fields, a port for building airships and mines for extracting ore. The kudiyars travel to this allod precisely to work.

The Allod of the Red Forest

The second cable car leads to the second allod, the Red Forest. It was on this allod that the kudiyars found themselves after the Cataclysm. It is covered with trees of extraordinary red foliage. Wild animals live in the forest.

Version 0.1 – The first version of the project.

Version 0.2 – Added the map of Irene Palace. Filled in the Ferris section and astral island 76 (thanks to Evpraksiya). Lots of small fixes and improvements. Initial layout of the raids. Updated the description of Grok. Added the islands from Evpraksiya's list.

Version 0.3 – Added more astral islands from the early (beta) versions of AO (thanks to Rpikt), added descriptions to most of the astral islands. Improved some descriptions (thanks to Evgeny Ptitsyn). Added descriptions to some story islands (from AA, for those that had them). Added the map of Goblinball Stadium. Updated Irene (current versions of the maps). The “Unsorted” section was updated. The Pearl Ring was filled in, the Interreality was added. Some old versions of island maps appeared. Lots of small fixes and improvements.

Version 0.4 – Added Freedom Isle (the anarchist aviaks of the Pearl Ring). Added the fan allod Copperlock. Fixes to Ferris and Ammer. Added descriptions of the islands near Umoir. Improved the list and the descriptions of the open-beta islands. Added boss lists for the Astral Islands and the Reflections. Added the island of Suslanger from AO times. Added the Mausoleum of Sparks and the Arena of Heroes. Added the never-released Free City (Tortuga).

Version 0.5 – Added the Astral Trading Post, the Astral Factory, the Astral Manufactory, The Thing (beta island), Liberation (beta island); updated the Zalesky Patrimony island (beta island) and the Refuge of the Outcasts. Minor changes and additions.
